scope: Codex CLI, explicitly loaded skill, real Python utility/CLI library maintenance tasks. Claude excluded at user request.

corpus.admission: Verified first parent, base fails changed frozen tests, fix passes changed tests and whole-file guard suite; no collection/setup errors; all rules applied before model runs.

partition.task_sampling: Seeded repository-stratified interleaving; no case selected using model outcomes.
partition.formal_and_replication: Disjoint untouched tasks after pilot. If pilot-derived size exceeds reserve, extend public corpus under the same admission rules before formal runs.
partition.pair_execution: A and B within a task/repeat execute sequentially; independent pairs may run concurrently.

metrics.token_cost_per_accepted: Sum reported input_tokens + output_tokens across all valid runs, including failed task attempts, divided by accepted runs. Cached input is a subset, not added twice.
metrics.time_per_accepted: Sum client execution seconds plus independent grading seconds across all runs divided by accepted runs. Setup and queue waiting excluded; skill read, exploration, testing, in-agent retries included.
metrics.correctness: Same frozen upstream whole-file guard suite for both arms; candidate tests/config cannot replace the grader. Require nonzero and matching test count.
metrics.observed_quality_gate: Skill accepted-run rate must be >= baseline in each confirmatory batch. Report quality uncertainty and worsened tasks; this is not a universal no-regression guarantee.
metrics.missing_usage: Never treat missing usage as zero. If any task-attempt usage is missing, token-saving proof is unavailable unless a conservative full bound is available; wall-time evidence remains separately reportable.

statistical_plan.hypothesis: Cost ratio R = skill/baseline. Benefit requires upper one-sided 97.5% confidence bound <0.90.
statistical_plan.multiple_comparisons: At most two benefit claims (token/time); alpha=.025 each gives familywise alpha <=.05 by union bound.
statistical_plan.ci: Paired task-cluster percentile bootstrap, 20000 draws, all repeats of a task kept together, seed fixed. Report two-sided 95% interval and gain interval.
statistical_plan.pilot_planning: Jackknife task pseudovalue SD of log overall cost ratio; plan for R=0.80 versus null boundary R=0.90, power=.80, z(.975)+z(.80). Floor planning SD at .05.
statistical_plan.formal_task_count: ceil required n, minimum20 maximum80 per batch; use max required n across token/time. If needed>80, cap and state underpowered rather than claim adequacy.
statistical_plan.confirmation: Run a second disjoint held-out batch of same size after the formal batch, using unchanged skill, metric and thresholds. Benefit claim requires both batches to meet the corresponding bound and observed quality gate.
statistical_plan.no_optional_stopping: No looking at formal outcomes to change sample size, task eligibility, skill, or success metric. Only operational health may interrupt.
statistical_plan.interpretation: Passing functional checks is not itself evidence of speed/token benefit. Final outcome may be effective, not demonstrated, or inconclusive.

operational_rules.no_additional_approval_needed: User explicitly authorized full validation after the proposed paired/repeated path.
